verdict.rationale: Baseten is a managed inference and training platform, so asking whether it can be self-hosted is a fair question. However, every doc describes Baseten provisioning and running workloads on its own managed GPUs and clusters, with nothing about deploying the platform yourself. The open-source Truss packaging library ('write once, run anywhere') is a developer building block for packaging models, not a self-hostable version of Baseten's core platform, so it earns no credit.
